decisions.reason: After remaining on the market for another year, this standalone psychiatric offer carries higher sunk costs and public commitment, and any weaker results can still be justified as temporary ramp-up issues in a core service area.

The firm has now invested longer in this visibly launched workshop and, because it fits its rehabilitation and production capabilities, management is likely to persist rather than reverse course quickly.

Its close link to eldercare and its prominent presentation create strong justification pressures, so management would be reluctant to withdraw it after two years unless results were clearly untenable.

Although retail is more peripheral and the offer is less prominently presented, the product extends sheltered workshop activities and the extra year of operation increases the tendency to continue it.

This newer and less visibly committed service is more exposed to being cut if operations disappoint, but its fit with senior support and the firm's expansion path still makes continued commitment more likely than withdrawal for now.
